Rule 1: -np 1 stays explicit (llama-server's default is auto = 4 slots); any speculation keeps -np 1. Rule 4: MTP for this model only as -md ${WEIGHTS_DIR}/.../mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-{Q8_0,BF16,Q4_K_M}.gguf --spec-type draft-mtp -np 1, never a -shared- file, -hfd or -hf ... --mtp (N18); speculation is switched on only by a measurement (ROADMAP R4.4). Rule 3: clients never send "reasoning_content": null (HTTP 500 at common/chat.cpp:422-423@79e2e74); tools/gateway/gateway.py drops it. Rule 6: slot files are restored only through tools/kv/session_store.py, never by a raw /slots?action=restore of an unchecked file (N8: 26/26 corrupted files accepted raw). Rule 11: do not change reasoning_effort inside a session (full re-processing, N14); this template runs --jinja WITHOUT a template file, i.e. the GGUF's built-in template, which maps "high" to "xhigh" without HTTP 500 (N15); where reasoning is not needed use chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} (EXTRA_BODY).
